parsed.impact: The changes are `checkDecks` in `src/content/checks.ts`, 21 reworded questions in `src/content/decks/3-plus.json`, the content record and the AC-01-02-4/-5 tests. Later decks (US-01-03 and US-01-04) and the MOD-03 screens that read `src/content` inherit the stricter duplicate check and the deck data. A later deck reusing a question text, even with different case or spacing, now fails the suite, which is intended. Nothing in the app UI changed.

findings.text: src/content/decks/3-plus.json (3p-01,03,05,12,18,20,21,28,30,33,35,39,41,44,45,46,47,49) — in 18 of the 20 either/or questions the correct option is named first, and only 3p-19 and 3p-23 put it second, so a child or a screen showing the text as written can score by always picking the first option → put the correct option second in about half of them, in pl and en together

src/content/decks/3-plus.json:3p-04 — "Jaki kształt ma koło samochodu?" / "Okrągły." gives away its answer because "koło" already means circle or wheel, a child will say "kółko" or "circle", and "koło samochodu" can be read as the preposition "near the car" → ask "Jaki kształt ma piłka?" or leave it for the owner review

src/content/decks/3-plus.json:3p-43 — "round toy that bounces on the floor" could also get "balon" (balloon) from a 3-year-old, since a balloon does bounce lightly (unlikely but possible) → add "and you kick it" (kopiemy) or leave it for the owner review

src/content/decks/3-plus.json:3p-42,3p-48,3p-40,3p-50 — open questions that allow near-miss answers: 3p-42 "kapelusz" or "kaptur", 3p-48 "komin" or "golf", 3p-40 "ogień" (fire), 3p-50 "marchewka" (carrot); a parent judging would accept them → not blocking; if wanted make them either/or, e.g. "Co zdmuchujemy na torcie: świeczki czy klocki?"
src/content/decks/3-plus.json:3p-08 — "Czym widzisz?" / "Oczami." a child who wears glasses will answer "okularami" (glasses) → make it either/or ("oczami czy uszami?") or leave it

src/content/decks/3-plus.json:3p-19,3p-22,3p-25,3p-44 — words a 3-year-old may not know: "tonie / sinks" and "metalowy", "pogodny day", "supper", and in 3p-25 "bardzo gorąca woda" (steam versus bubbles) → "dinner" reads more natural than "supper" in en although "kolacja" maps to supper; otherwise acceptable since the age check uses a parent reading aloud
src/content/decks/3-plus.json:3p-02 — Polish answer "Dwoje." is correct for "dwoje oczu" but sounds odd and a child says "dwa" → use "Dwa." as in 3p-13 or leave it
src/content/decks/3-plus.json:3p-33 — "ribbit" is the American onomatopoeia while the deck spells "colour" British → use "croak" or settle the English variant, fine for the owner review

src/content/checks.ts:93 — the duplicate-text message prints the lower-cased, trimmed text, not the text as written in the deck, so it is harder to grep → report the original text and compare the normalised one (the test would need updating)

criteria.note: exactly 50 questions, one answer string in pl and en; AC-01-02-1 test and checks pass
length limits are enforced by checkDeck and the AC-01-02-2 test, which passes locally
AC-01-02-3 test passes, and the deck has 13/12/13/12 by kind

the record has 50 rows and every row matches the deck in pl and en; the AC-01-02-4 test requires exactly the record's 8 columns and all four checks pass; it cannot verify that the checks were really made, the owner reviews all content before release (DEC-26)

the content checks cover count, one answer, length, kinds, unique id, unique text and unique category with failing-case tests that assert exact messages; the test suite passes locally; CI emulator run was still pending, re-check it
content is JSON data with a loader, and the AC-01-02-6 test passes
locally the release APK bundle holds all decks in pl and en and has no network permissions (AC-01-02-7 step 2, test-runs/2026-10-14_160342); CI emulator run was still pending, re-check it
